entries.name: SMS
entries.description: Send an SMS to any US/Canada number, paid in Cashu sats.
entries.announcement: ContextVM SMS service. Send a text message to any +1 number. Flat price, paid per message with Cashu ecash escrow; undelivered sends are refunded. No account required.

entries.name: WhatsApp
entries.description: Send a WhatsApp message, paid in Cashu sats.
entries.announcement: ContextVM WhatsApp service. Delivery runs over the official Android client. This rail is not connected in this release, so no payment can be taken.
